verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a hosted REST API for running AI browser tasks (smooth-docs-20, smooth-docs-13) and explicitly says results come back by polling (smooth-docs-36). Supporting task endpoints exist to list and cancel tasks (smooth-docs-37, smooth-docs-38), and the browser runs on Smooth's infrastructure rather than the user's machine (smooth-comm-11). The docs state that webhooks are not offered, but the story accepts polling as an alternative. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of the HTTP submit/poll flow specifically.
